Great Video. Learning a ton.  I appreciate it.  Couple questions.  Regarding the video that gets generated.  Does either of the AI services provide an optimized web friendly version of the video.  I was curious about the file size and I saw your video was 40mb for 5 second.  I ran the video through FFMPEG with the following string - ffmpeg -i turn.mp4 -r 24 -c:v libx264 -crf 28 -preset veryslow -movflags +faststart -pix_fmt yuv420p -an turn_crf28.mp4 and created a 2mb file that looks really good.  I did a version where I stepped on it all the way down to 434 kb and I have to say it still was not bad.  When you setup your prompts, can you have Claude optimize the video?  Can you build FFMPEG into Claude so you don't have to know how to set the switches when optimizing.  I know this is slightly out of the range of the spirit of the training video you provided but since the hero is a video I thought it applied.  I was just wondering related to load time, if there is anything setup to accommodate how the video loads and reacts to the users mouse. Thanks again for the video and I look forward to your response to hopefully learn a little more about what Claude and Claude Design can do.
